HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period.
   B. Say Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period as rumours only.
   D. Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Colonialism in Contemporary Society is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonialism in Contemporary Society.
   C. Treat Colonialism in Contemporary Society as rumours only.
   D. Say Colonialism in Contemporary Society never happens in Kenya.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

4. Which statement about Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

6. Which statement about Human developmen ts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human developmen ts in Africa.
   B. Explain Human developmen ts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human developmen ts in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Human developmen ts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha.
   D. Treat Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.
   C. Say Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   D. Treat Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence as rumours only.
   B. Say Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence.
   D. Explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya.
   C. Treat Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan innovations and their adoption in other nations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A — Explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. C — Nairobi

4. A — Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan innovations and their adoption in other nations; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Colonialism in Contemporary Society; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
